wppo-researcher.description: Read-only research orchestrator for the WordPress feature monitor. Full shell is available for read-only verification (jq/echo and beyond) — but no file writes/edits and no gh/issue commands (the research job has no GitHub token). Returns findings as JSON text.

wppo-lane-researcher.description: Read-only research lane (Task-invoked). Full shell is available for read-only verification — but no file writes/edits and no gh/issue commands (no GitHub token). Returns findings as message text.

wppo-issue-publisher.description: Files GitHub issues for pre-validated Tier-A findings via gh CLI. Shell is scoped to gh issue create/list, sleep, and jq/echo for mandatory final-JSON self-verification. No edits, no web tools, no shell beyond that.

wppo-reviewer.description: Read-only review orchestrator for the experimental fast-review path. Fans out file review to wppo-review-lane subagents, merges JSON findings returned as message text, and returns exactly one findings JSON document. Full shell is available for read-only verification — but no file writes/edits and no gh/issue/PR commands.

wppo-review-lane.description: Read-only review lane (Task-invoked). Reviews ~3 assigned files and returns JSON findings as message text; cannot edit files or write anything to disk, cannot run gh/issue/PR commands, cannot spawn subagents.
